review_type: fresh independent zero-product-authorship source review and pending native acceptance
source_findings: Profile reads users.user_form_profile through usersDb, filtered by the current authenticated owner's user_id. A denied read, missing row, and malformed row have distinct outcomes; the restricted context RPC is not used.

The hook binds loaded state to an owner lifetime and read sequence. The first render after identity change masks the prior draft, a stale save continuation cannot start an old-owner read, and a same-tick refresh invalidates the loaded baseline before Save.
A failed initial or post-save read presents an alert with Retry. ProfileView hides editors and dirty footer and disables the header Save; the hook refuses writes until a successful owner read.

native.required: Admin T02 and T04 real save/reopen/restore; denied owner-row read and Retry through a real browser network boundary; identity transition remains partial if real UI cannot be exercised.

limits: Mocked source tests cannot prove RLS or native persistence. No overall Profile inventory pass is claimed. Member behavior and real cross-identity UI remain unverified.
